name: bb-vim-keys
description: Vim-style keys for bb plugin surfaces: one keymap table in vim notation, a key reader for gg/dd-style sequences and counts, a window listener scoped to a plugin's root, row-list cursors, and the shortcuts grid. The root entry imports nothing, so node's test runner and content scripts can load it; ./react adds hooks and the grid, importing only modules bb shims to the host.
